name: nature-reviewer
description: Simulate a Nature-style reviewer assessment: pre-submission review, reviewer report, novelty/significance/technical soundness critique from the referee perspective.

interface.shortDescription: Nature-style reviewer assessment from the referee perspective.
defaultPrompt: Review my manuscript like a Nature referee
interface.longDescription: Produces a reviewer report covering novelty, significance, and technical soundness, written from the referee perspective rather than as an author rebuttal.
